rca_of_the_issue: Bug found: App.js referenced <QuoteBuilder/> and <ProductsCatalog/> in <Route> without importing the modules. Result: instant runtime crash on any route. Fix: added the two import statements. Reproduction: navigate to any URL → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' screen with `ReferenceError: QuoteBuilder is not defined`. Mitigation: verify all new page components are imported at the top of App.js.
